quotes.speaker: Ousmane Dieng
quotes.summary_phrase: Ousmane Dieng explains his decision to re-sign with the Milwaukee Bucks.
quotes.quote: Since I got here last year I had more opportunities, more reps. It felt good with the team, the city, the fans, so I feel like it was the obvious choice for me, honestly.
quotes.social_post: Ousmane Dieng says re-signing with the Milwaukee Bucks was the obvious choice because of the opportunities, the city, and the fans.

quotes.speaker: Ousmane Dieng
quotes.summary_phrase: Ousmane Dieng shares his advice for younger players on finding their role in the NBA.
quotes.quote: I feel like just find your role. Just do whatever the team needs you to do to win and you will be all right.
quotes.social_post: Ousmane Dieng shares his advice for younger players, saying you just have to find your role and do whatever the team needs to win.

quotes.speaker: Ousmane Dieng
quotes.summary_phrase: Ousmane Dieng highlights Coach Doc Rivers' focus on defense during training camp.
quotes.quote: Probably the defensive end. He is a really defensive minded coach, so that is great. I feel like that is great for us.
quotes.social_post: Ousmane Dieng says Doc Rivers is a really defensive minded coach and that his focus on the defensive end is great for the team.
